prompted_for: A whole PW page told with pictures (target for the page rhythm)
composition: long single-column page split into two strips side by side
sections alternate deep navy and cream bands
centred section titles with small subtitles
hero with large isometric wireframe skid and four KPI chips below
each band has one dominant diagram or tile grid
layout_devices: isometric wireframe hero with leader-line callouts
semicircle gauge dials with bar meters
left-to-right process flow with labelled equipment
decision-tree selector with diamond node and checkbox outcomes
capex range chart with labelled range bars
two-column FAQ accordion with plus toggles
palette: steel-blue fills on KPI chips and gauges
typography: centred sans title-case headings, regular weight
line_and_texture: hairline 1 px white strokes on navy
flat fills, no grain or shadow
motion_implied: gauges sweep to their limit values
water travels through the process flow left to right
decision tree branches light up per feed type
t2i_keywords: alternating deep navy and cream section bands
white hairline line art on navy
process flow diagram left to right
t2i_prompt: Full-length B2B industrial website page mockup, long scroll, sections alternating deep navy and warm cream bands. Hero on navy with a large isometric white-hairline wireframe of <CONTENT> and leader-line callouts, a row of steel-blue KPI chips below. Following bands: semicircle gauge dashboard, left-to-right schematic process flow, decision-tree selector, bordered icon spec tiles, range bar chart, document icon grid, two-column FAQ accordion, related product tiles, centred enquiry form, footer. Flat vector line art, navy on cream and white on navy, centred title-case sans headings, engineering datasheet look.
signature_idea: Every section of the product page is carried by its own engineering picture, alternating navy and cream like pages of a datasheet.
strengths: proves a rhythm where each section has a visual job
alternating bands give clear section breaks
gauges, selector and process flow map to real buyer questions
consistent line-art language across very different sections
weaknesses: centred headings, not left-aligned Geist light
brand_fit_why: Palette and line art are on-brand, but the clutter, centred mid-weight headings and lack of space-as-material break the calm precise brief.
